data_layout: 15 records at0x012e99e8,44 bytes each. Each record contains a country-list pointer,32-bit country count and six6-byte channel groups. Country IDs are compared as little-endian16-bit stored values. Group fields0..4 are class,band,step,first,count. The sixth group byte is unused by0x012e9e7c.
method: Read committed NONMATCHING C as a guide, then inspect actual stock instructions with arm-none-eabi-objdump -D -b binary -m arm --adjust-vma=0x01100000. Decode country IDs and group field facts directly from the authenticated image with little-endian DataView reads. Published Rust contains distilled country/channel facts, not proprietary C or raw image tables.
behavior: An existing cached selection is returned before examining EEPROM mode or country.
EEPROM mode1 with index0..14 selects that exact stock profile. Invalid indices fall through to country lookup.
EEPROM mode2 selects the raw EEPROM custom-group region. The cached selection continues to reference current custom-group contents.
Other modes scan all15 country lists in order and select the first matching16-bit country ID.
An unknown country selects the last profile at0x012e9c50, whose2.4GHz group covers channels1..13 and final5GHz group begins149 with count7.
The chosen table is cached independently of the country copied into the outgoing rate command. Explicit invalidation re-enables selection, matching the invalidation at0x01299c08.
Serialization always preserves group class and band. Only bands1 and2 copy step,first,count. Unknown band bytes remain visible but their channel-range fields serialize as zero.

HardwareConfiguration now supplies RegulatoryInput parsed from raw EEPROM mode,index,custom bytes and flag bytes. It no longer accepts preselected computed groups. configure executes selection before building the rate command.

api.RegulatoryInput::country: Country selection with the supplied raw hardware flags.
api.RegulatoryInput::from_eeprom: Parse raw mode,index,six6-byte custom records and flags into closed selection variants.
api.RegulatorySelector::select: Resolve and cache the profile in owned CPU, returning borrowed selected group facts.
api.Adapter::invalidate_regulatory_selection: Clear cached selection for a country/configuration update.

tests.behavior: All15 profile selections, Japanese channel14, Canadian split ranges, indexed and custom paths, invalid-index and unknown-mode/country fallback, cache retention/invalidation and outgoing command bytes.
tests.execution: Written and unrun by assignment. No builds, tests, linters, formatters, native comparisons, SDK or live operations.
